```sql
WITH groton_region AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Groton'
    AND border_type = 'city'
    AND ST_GeometryType(geometry) = 'ST_Polygon'
  LIMIT 1
),
nature_reserves_in_groton AS (
  SELECT park_name, geometry
  FROM parks
  WHERE leisure = 'nature_reserve'
    AND ST_Intersects(geometry::geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM groton_region)::geometry)
),
largest_nature_reserve AS (
  SELECT park_name, geometry
  FROM nature_reserves_in_groton
  ORDER BY ST_Area(geometry::geometry) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
raster_clip AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geometry FROM largest_nature_reserve)::geometry)
),
max_elevation AS (
  SELECT MAX((ST_Value(rast, 1, (SELECT geometry FROM largest_nature_reserve)::geometry)).val) AS max_elevation
  FROM raster_clip
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT park_name FROM largest_nature_reserve) AS park_name,
  (SELECT max_elevation FROM max_elevation) AS max_elevation;
```
